We need to compute total revenue for March 2026 per billing region (NA, EU, APAC) for completed orders only. Let's start by listing all orders for month "2026-03". We'll need to paginate through all orders, get each order's details (status, amount), and for completed ones, look up the customer to get their region.

First, let me list orders for page 1 to see how many there are.

input.script:
-- Step 1: List all orders for 2026-03, paginating through all pages
local month = "2026-03"
local page = 1
local all_orders = {}

repeat
  local result = tool("list_orders", { month = month, page = page })
  for _, order in ipairs(result.items) do
    table.insert(all_orders, order)
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > result.total_pages

-- Step 2: For each order, get details and customer region
local totals = { NA = 0, EU = 0, APAC = 0 }

for _, order in ipairs(all_orders) do
  local order_detail = tool("get_order", { id = order.id })
  if order_detail.status == "completed" then
    local customer = tool("get_customer", { id = order.customer_id })
    if totals[customer.region] then
      totals[customer.region] = totals[customer.region] + order_detail.amount_cents
    end
  end
end

return {
  totals = totals,
  order_count = #all_orders,
  completed_count = (function()
    local c = 0
    for _, o in ipairs(all_orders) do
      local d = tool("get_order", { id = o.id })
      if d.status == "completed" then c = c + 1 end
    end
    return c
  end)()
}
